does it have to do with this change that was made on the last bug fix   framework/gpu/buffer_upload.zig — the one sanctioned
  upload module:
  - bytesOf(T, slice) / bytesOfCount(T, count) — byte
  size computed in u64, so the multiply can't overflow
  for any real buffer.
  - writeTypedBuffer(queue, buf, offset, T, slice) —
  size derived from the slice's own element type (count
  and element size can't disagree), bounds-checked 
  against the destination buffer and logs the offender
  in safety builds.
  - writeValue(queue, buf, offset, &value) —
  single-struct uploads (uniforms, lone rows).
  
  Every queue.writeBuffer and every setVertexBuffer
  byte-range across the GPU layer now routes through it
  — rects, capsules, curves, polys, SDF icons, glyph
  text, gcurve fill, image quads, effect storage data,
  all the uniform structs, terrain vertices, instance
  rows, the ground D stream. A grep confirms zero count 
  * @sizeOf(T) left outside the helper.
